records.title: Federated Nested Learning: Collaborative Training of Self-Referential Memories for Test-Time Adaptation
records.reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1–4: FedNL learns client-local test-time memory adaptation rules using a fixed-size Titans-style memory state, Delta Rule updates, and federated aggregation. The paper frames adaptation/accuracy under non-IID data, not inference efficiency; no LLM deployment latency/KV-memory result is presented. Potential memory architecture adjacency is weak and compute overhead remains unquantified.

records.title: Safety Anchor: Defending Harmful Fine-tuning via Geometric Bottlenecks
records.reason: Safety Anchor addresses harmful fine-tuning defenses rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: SMolLM: Small Language Models Learn Small Molecular Grammar
records.reason: Primary arXiv HTML, method and experiments: SMolLM is a 53K-parameter weight-shared transformer for SMILES molecular grammar, reporting 95% validity and molecular-design evaluation. Its small parameter count is notable, but the domain-specific task and quality objective do not establish general LLM inference efficiency, nor report serving latency/memory comparisons. Keep as weak compact-language-model architecture adjacency.

records.title: How Well Do LLMs Perform on the Simplest Long-Chain Reasoning Tasks: An Empirical Study on the Equivalence Class Problem
records.reason: This is an empirical LLM reasoning benchmark study; the abstract supplies no method for improving inference cost/latency/memory.

records.title: FER-EMFormer: An enhanced mamba-transformer network for facial expression recognition
records.reason: Facial-expression recognition architecture is an application-specific vision model, not language-model inference.
